posts.text: To be clear this list will include the single best piece of fiction ever written, “The Other World's Books Depend on the Bean Counter”

Been watching a ton of anime recently and might have to make a tier list video for the stuff I've watched so far

It's all S+ so far as a baseline so it'll just be a matter of additional pluses 

Well, mostly.

Pam Bondi is apparently out as AG

Perhaps she can take up a new career as a defendant at The Hague

I wrote a bit about Microsoft's generational run of pushing unnecessary—sometimes dangerous—features into their core products and what the impact of that has been

Read it here: www.skh.news/microslop-au...
I don't have speech patterns I just have a vast library of vocal stims and a shuffle button
I like how some designer at apple was like "okay and when they're in the edit mode for the home screen then everything gets all wiggly jiggly y'know?"
The moon? We still have one of those?

Some highlights from my Satisfactory episode today up on my fun times channel

Watch the full episode yonder: www.youtube.com/watch?v=UsjT...

The latest episode of my Satisfactory lets play just posted! Join me in my ultimate journey to ascend the throne and become the Queen I was always meant to be (or a princess, I kinda go back and forth on that)

Watch me flail: www.youtube.com/watch?v=UsjT...

Wild how many email filters I’ve got set up just to catch the flood of "Hello, {name}! I stumbled across your content and thought you’d be a perfect fit to partner with us for our AI-powered product!" emails and I still get a few a day
Just to be clear: I am not among the astronauts going to space today
Deeply unserious government
We can't be more interested in preserving business models than basic humanity and expect to flourish in any meaningful way
More like April Cools 😎

Oh I should do an April fools gag huh

Uh

I dislike bagels and dogs

april jokes

There is no award for being The Most Aware And Concerned out of everyone

Hold your passions and morals strongly but careful to not mistake showings of outrage and misery for progress

And if it's to raise awareness—direction works wonders over chastising someone for not being upset enough

(This person is, to my eye at least, clearly in need of professional help and it may be better to block them given how aggressively unhinged their position seems to be)

(And also anyone who asserts that criticizing democrats strictly means you’re a fossil fuel supporter is busted anyway)
Maybe we all just kinda stop and look at some birds for a bit before making any more decisions about the future
